title: Bump opum-quest pin to quest-cli v0.7.1
description: Follow-up to OMARK-50's pattern: quest 0.7.1 is npm-published (dist-tags.latest 0.7.1 on the main package plus darwin-arm64, linux-x64, win32-x64, checked 2026-09-15) and this repo's managed block moved to 0.7.1 in OMARK-55, so the pin catches up. v0.7.1 is a LIGHTWEIGHT tag (ref points straight at commit 925801892f40527e1645734d64e687836e3ee0cd), unlike v0.7.0 which was annotated; check-federated-content.mjs handles both. Root tree 06c3846db9649b5620f8e11a7aeecbb6e920d069, skills subtree 633c776b3c40ae54ffd1c8cc6fbd7329d03bdd40, byte-identical to the v0.6.0 and v0.7.0 baselines. plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.7.1.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json opum-quest ref and the federated-pin-baselines.json opum-quest entry move to v0.7.1 together in one change
Tag chain re-resolved via the GitHub API and recorded in the baseline note; plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.7.1
Both federated checkers and both regression suites pass locally; the PR run is green on all three jobs with both live federated checks OK (cite run id)
